items.title: *** Data Protection Day 2027: Protecting the vulnerable ***
items.description: *** Data Protection Day 2027: Protecting the vulnerable *** Your chance to shape the discussion is coming closer. Save the date! # DPD2027 takes place on 29 January 2027 at the European Parliament in Brussels. Mark your calendars! 📍 Where: European Parliament, Brussels (in person and online) 🗓️ When: 29 January 2027 Data Protection Day celebrates the signing of Convention 108, the first legally binding international treaty protecting privacy. To mark the occasion, we're co-organising a one-day conference with the Council of Europe. As AI and other digital technologies become part of everyday public and private life, measures meant to promote fairness, safety and security can also create new risks for privacy, autonomy and other fundamental rights. The topics explored will range from manipulative practices and AI-driven discrimination to online harms for minors and data sharing in law enforcement and border management. How do we make sure those risks don't fall hardest on the people least able to bear them? 🔎 Find out more here: https:// data-protection-day.eu/ 📹 In the meantime, take a look back at key moments from Data Protection Day 2026. Watch with us! 👇
